name: chamahub
description: ChamaHub — Every Chama. Every Contribution. One Place.

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w @chamahub/api -w @chamahub/admin -w @chamahub/mobile
scripts.dev:setup: npm run build:shared && npm exec -w @chamahub/api -- prisma migrate deploy && npm run db:seed
